# Ryan Dundas — Video Production (Orlando, FL)

Ryan Dundas is a freelance video production professional based in
Orlando, Florida, serving Central Florida and available to travel.
He offers run-and-gun camera work, drone video and photography,
green screen and virtual studio production, virtual tours, and
video editing, from the shoot to the final edit. Production
companies also book him for specific crew roles: director of
photography, camera operator, camera assistant, drone operator,
video editor, motion graphics artist, and assistant editor. He has
10+ years of experience on reality TV shows, in post production as
an assistant editor and in the camera department, and works with
Business Video Solutions.

## Services

**Camera & Run-and-Gun**: Fast, reliable camera work for
commercials, events, interviews, and branded content, with or
without a full crew.

**Drone Video & Photography**: Aerial cinematography and stills with
DJI drones. Ryan's drone work has aired on HGTV, Lifetime, and DIY
Network.

**Green Screen & Virtual Studio**: Full green screen and virtual
studio production for presenters, explainers, and branded segments.

**Editing & Post**: Editing, color grading, and audio mixing.
Experienced assistant editor for television and digital content.

**Virtual Tours**: Immersive walkthroughs of venues, listings, and
spaces.

**Brand & Corporate Video**: Narrative-driven brand films, promos,
and corporate content.

**AI-Generated Video**: Ryan can incorporate AI-generated video into
a project. Samples: AI Video Clip Reel, My Pet Peed Pet 80's movie
spoofs, and the Legends of the Arena podcast opener.

## Reality TV

10+ years on reality TV shows, in post production as an assistant
editor and on set in the camera department.

## Past Clients and Employers

Past clients include AdventHealth, Keke's Breakfast Cafe, Fed Gov
Today, NDSS, My Pet Peed, IV Lounge, and Orlando Roof Tech. Past
employers include AL Media Strategy, Pink Sneakers Productions,
OAKZ Media, Open Water Studios, and True Entertainment.

## Selected Work

Commercial/promo (Keke's Breakfast Cafe, Blake Hanson, Orlando Roof
Tech, Weediatrics), documentary (Take A Chance For Charity featuring
Mark Tremonti, AdventHealth for Children, Miles Christi), interviews
(Fed Gov Today, Mic Drop Sports Orlando Magic interviews), green
screen (NDSS Lumind, BrainShift, Freedaps), and social ads (Domi
Ice, Spine Labs, Spartan Plumbing, Bumblebee Blinds, Debary Truck
Sales, Enjuku Racing).

## Equipment

Cinema cameras (RED Epic Dragon, Canon cinema bodies), DJI drones,
broadcast-quality audio, lighting, and green screen / virtual studio
setups. Gear is matched to each project.

## FAQ

Q: What video services does Ryan Dundas offer?
A: Run-and-gun camera work, drone video and photography, green screen
and virtual studio production, virtual tours, and full editing. He is
also an experienced assistant editor for TV and digital content.

Q: Where is Ryan Dundas based?
A: Orlando, Florida. He covers all of Central Florida and is
available to travel across the US and beyond.

Q: Can Ryan handle a full production or just filming?
A: Either. He can run a project start to finish, from filming through
editing and delivery, or join an existing crew in a specific role:
director of photography, camera operator, camera assistant, drone
operator, video editor, motion graphics artist, or assistant editor.

Q: What equipment does Ryan Dundas use?
A: Cinema cameras (RED Epic Dragon, Canon cinema bodies), DJI drones,
broadcast audio, lighting, and green screen / virtual studio setups.
